fusions.name: Bedrock Stamp
fusions.desc: A stamp on an enemy at or below 25% health that deals 24 rock damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises by 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Rubble Thump
fusions.desc: A hard landing that deals 10 rock damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stuns them for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Kicked-Up Wall
fusions.desc: Kicks up a wall of stone 4 tiles long that nothing crosses for 6 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Grit Crust
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover give you a shield of 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
